rationale: A token orbits the Model block's border (a path that is no flow) and the Output block blinks forever. Both are decoration: no flow type binds them and they add no meaning. The static critic sees one extra 3px circle on a block edge and scores 10. Check: every offset-path must equal (or be a reversal-free sub-path of) a data-flow/marker-end path's d; every infinite or alternate animation must target a pulse token; blocks and labels may only animate opacity once (reveal). Side finding: the four 3px tokens count as blocks, so topology.ungrouped ('7 blocks without any grouping') fires on a three-block figure; pulse tokens (data-role=pulse) must be excluded from the block set.
